job: Run the public status page: post incident updates after a preview, set each component's state and schedule maintenance.
purpose: An operator's app screen behind the public status page: a page head with View public page and Open an incident, a strip of what the public reads now, the open incident with its updates on a timeline beside a composer that previews the update and its reach (fd-preview, fd-impact) before a held publish with Undo (fd-commit in a held toast), a table of components whose state changes at once with Done and Undo, and scheduled maintenance.
useWhen: Operators tell customers about an incident or planned work, and every word goes out to subscribers.
A component's public state has to change during an incident, with a way to take it back.

avoidWhen.when: Customers read the status; nobody edits it.
The product only needs to show its own health in the top bar.
The change waits for someone else to approve it.

states.name: incident
states.how: ?state=incident, or the Demo state band; an open incident with its updates and the composer; fd-states data-state="ready"

states.name: all-clear
states.how: ?state=all-clear, or resolving the incident; fd-states data-state="empty": no open incident, with Open an incident

states.name: maintenance
states.how: ?state=maintenance, or the Demo state band; maintenance underway in place of the incident, with Mark complete

states.name: read-only
states.how: ?state=read-only, or the Demo state band; every control is disabled and described by a line that names the on-call operators (fd-reason, fd-commit-lock)

states.name: loading
states.how: ?state=loading, or the Demo state band; first paint shows it for about 600 ms; data-state="loading" shows stat, card and table skeletons

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error, or the Demo state band; data-state="error" with the request ID and Try again
